notes: New plugins target Plugin API 1.11.0; Plugin API 1.10.0 packages remain loadable.
Plugin API 1.11 adds domain-neutral ScientificCurveSurface manipulators: point, axis and range with generic preview/commit/reset lifecycle.
Feature-specific marker/FWHM drag callbacks remain compatibility adapters only.
The SDK is standalone and does not require DK Data Studio source code.
Domain logic belongs to plugins; application infrastructure is consumed through ctx.* Core APIs.
